name: run

versions.rationale: Seed implementation from the plan (Developer workflow: CLI); small enough to build and test on day one.

Takes the repository root as an optional third argument (default: the working directory) so commands that read the store can be tested against a temporary repo, and runs `poetics changes`, the first command that does real work. Unknown refs exit 2 as invalid arguments; `--impact` is not implemented until the indexer lands.

docs: Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 findings (e.g. verify), 2 usage or not-implemented. `root` is the repository root.
